minutes.headline: Zoning board voted to grant a special permit for lot-width relief so a new house can replace the old one at 18 Buttonwood Place.
minutes.summary: The board heard one case: a petition to reconfigure the lot lines of 18 and 20 Buttonwood Place, move land for a new septic system, and replace the existing dwelling at 18. Members asked about access, the non-conforming status of the lot, how lot width is measured, and the septic and Board of Health requirements. A motion to grant the special permit was made and seconded, a vote was taken, and the meeting adjourned.

public_comment.topic: The applicant said he talked with his neighbors and received no negative responses. The chair noted that no public comment was asked for because no one from the public was present in the room, on Zoom or on YouTube.

votes.motion: Grant the special permit for dimensional variation as requested for the lot-width requirement at 18 Buttonwood Place.

passed (moved and seconded; all in favor called, tally not stated)

decisions.decision: Special permit granted with the standard post-decision conditions: compliance with all applicable regulations, periodic review, decision filed with the town clerk within 14 days, recording at the registry of deeds before it takes effect, and a two-year lapse unless use or construction has begun.
The board's staff will prepare the written decision for the chairman's signature and filing with the town clerk, with a copy sent to the applicant.
If the board approves, the applicant will then go to the planning board to record and endorse the plan of land; the Board of Health sign-off on the septic must come before a building permit.
